summary: Production-ready full-stack online printing and personalized gift platform (similar to Printo.in) with original branding. Frontend: Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Fabric.js, PWA. Backend: Node.js + Express, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Sharp, Razorpay, WhatsApp API. Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Railway/Render (backend), Supabase (DB/storage).
architectural_notes: Frontend: Next.js 14 + Tailwind CSS + Redux Toolkit + Fabric.js, deployed on Vercel
Backend: Node.js + Express, deployed on Railway/Render
Database/Storage: Supabase PostgreSQL + Supabase Storage (or AWS S3)
Auth: JWT-based, dual-role (user vs admin) determined by credentials
Payments: Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, COD) — India-focused
Image processing: Sharp server-side for 300 DPI print file generation
Admin credentials: username=genmitra password=12345678; User credentials: username=genmitra password=1234
CORS: Backend must whitelist all preview/deployment origins (e.g., *.caffeine.xyz) to prevent 'disallowed origin' errors in the editor
Admin login must use custom username/password form (genmitra/12345678) only — Internet Identity (id.ai/identity.ic0.app) must NOT be triggered for /admin authentication flow

Save functionality broken for both products and templates in admin panel — backend createProduct/updateProduct and createTemplate/updateTemplate calls not properly handling base64 image data from file upload controls

Admin gets 'Unauthorized: Only admins can manage products' error when saving products/templates even when logged in as admin — JWT role validation failing in backend middleware or token not attached correctly in frontend requests
Admin route /admin has no route guard — unauthenticated users can access the admin panel directly without logging in
Visiting /admin while logged out triggers Internet Identity (id.ai) instead of showing custom username/password login form — admin auth must bypass Internet Identity entirely
Admin login failing — credential validation not working for either admin account (genmitra/12345678 or admin/Admin@1234)
